description: Return the name, version, and runtime details of this opa-mcp server instance. Use this when you need to confirm which version of opa-mcp is running, to verify that the OPA, Regal, and Conftest binaries are reachable, or to see which directories file tools may use (allowedPaths) and whether they come from OPA_MCP_ALLOWED_PATHS or the client's roots.
